propositions: The workflow previously delegated checkout to a third-party action that could fetch one patchset refspec but check out a different requested patchset SHA, leaving HEAD on an unintended commit before the later guard detected the mismatch.

Run 33455923923 combined patchset-1 refspec (d6c37680805fc8ae013832dd4c09c1fb100a1e0b) with patchset-2 revision (a22257e7d10e3d079ee676cbb38d2b39811d0fd5), causing checkout to land on the stale refspec commit instead of the requested current patchset.

The workflow now validates that the fetched refspec resolves to the exact requested GERRIT_PATCHSET_REVISION SHA before checkout, with explicit error reporting for refspec/revision mismatch or unfetchable refspec.
The checkout plumbing tries the GitHub mirror first and falls back to Gerrit direct fetch if the mirror does not have the requested refspec.
The repair covers success, Gerrit fallback, stale-refspec mismatch, and unfetchable-refspec paths via unit tests against temporary git remotes.
